propositions: DC outbound status mutations are submitted as field edits via issue.update(fields=status) instead of being routed through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status edit and leave the issue status unchanged

the Cloud transport (jira/acli.py) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue_by_name, but the DC transport (jira_datacenter/transport.py) does not perform this routing, causing the two transports to behave differently for the same outbound status mutation
the root cause is that status-to-transition resolution was implemented once per transport and the DC implementation is missing the status routing that its Cloud sibling has
illegal transitions that cannot be reached from the current workflow state must fail gracefully as non-fatal bridge alerts rather than silently soft-failing or propagating as HTTPError

DC outbound status routing must pop status from kwargs before the field-edit call and dispatch it through route_status_to_transition while keeping other allowlisted fields in the same issue.update call
the outbound cell test_outbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status] fails on DC harness with 'outbound status did not reach DC' because the status never transitions
